The '''Colsassan moons'''<ref name="FOTJ:A" /> were a group of eleven [[Moon/Legends|moons]] that [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Colsassa]] located in the [[Adega system/Legends|Adega system]], a part of the [[Auril sector/Legends|Auril sector]]<ref name="TEA Colsassa" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion<ref name="TEA Adega" /> of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TEA Colsassa" /> By [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> a [[Unidentified Lost Tribe of Sith staging base|staging base]] of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] was located there.<ref name="FOTJ:A" />

==Appearances==
